groq.title: Root endpoint returns HTTP 500 due to intentional exception, causing browser test failure
groq.root_cause_summary: The FastAPI route defined at '/' deliberately raises an HTTPException with status code 500, citing an uninitialized database connection. Because this exception is unconditionally executed on every request, the server always responds with a 500 Internal Server Error. The browser test expects a 200 OK
groq.suggested_remediation: Remove or conditionally disable the deliberate HTTP 500 exception in the root route. Implement proper database connection initialization before handling requests, and ensure that the endpoint returns a valid HTML response with status 200 under normal operation.
